title: Canonical monoidal model of derived pullback
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. On the derived categories of modules [def-pc-derived-category], let $L=Lg^*$ be the recorded derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], equipped with the derived tensor structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. A canonical monoidal model of $L$ is a strong monoidal structure $m$ induced by termwise module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] as follows. There is an additive functor $F:\operatorname{Mod}(O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(O_T)$ agreeing on objects and arrows with that module pullback, a strong monoidal structure $m_F$ whose inverse tensorator is the recorded module pullback tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], and a left-derived counit $\epsilon:Q_hL\to K(F)Q_h$. The degreewise inverse tensorators induce the total-complex isomorphisms $\varphi_{P,N}:F(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N))\cong\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes FN)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]; equivalently, the composite of each summand inclusion with $\varphi$ is the module tensor comparison followed by the corresponding target summand inclusion. For every pair of K-flat complexes $P,N$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], the tensorator of $m$ is characterized by the equation $\mu_m(QP,QN);L(\mu_Q(P,N));\epsilon_{P\otimes N};Q(\varphi_{P,N})=(\epsilon_P\otimes\epsilon_N);\mu_Q(FP,FN)$, where semicolons mean composition in order and $\mu_Q$ is the localization tensor comparison. This is the descent of the canonical comparison [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product]. The unit isomorphism $O_T\cong L(O_X)$ is the one determined by the strong monoidal unit laws. Such models exist; their tensor and unit isomorphisms are used in defining canonical derived-Hom base change, and statements using them hold for every such model.
